Research runs:

- [2026-09-09-editor-performance-iteration-2](../../../plite/research/2026-09-09-editor-performance-iteration-2). Experiments E01–E26 cover Plite mount, publication, selectors, decoration manager and virtualization, Plate features and the React Compiler (plite); a nine-editor full-DOM comparison, Wordgard/ProseKit concept matrices and CodeMirror/VS Code mechanisms make it comparative (editor-architecture); it states Wordgard keymap precedence, text chunks, central-authority OT and table-map facts (wordgard), ProseKit derived-value hook, page rendering and virtual-selection test facts (prosekit), Slate chunk-on baseline and move/remove timings (slate), and lower ProseMirror 10k mount/structural times plus ProseKit's delegation to ProseMirror view and history (prosemirror).
- [2026-09-21-media-object-editable-content](../../../plite/research/2026-09-21-media-object-editable-content). Plite media object versus editable-caption semantics, backed by local Plate model probes and compared with ProseMirror atom/contentDOM, WordGard CaptionedFigure and Lexical DecoratorNode nested editors and named slots.
